title: St Peter's Basilica
blurb: The Papal Basilica of Saint Peter in the Vatican: 220 m long, with Michelangelo's 136.6 m dome, Maderno's 114 m facade, Bernini's bronze baldachin and his embracing colonnade around St Peter's Square.

sourceUrls.label: Opus Dei: 400 Years of the Basilica of Saint Peter
Bluffton: St. Peter's Basilica and Its Art
RIBA: St Peter's Basilica plan and aerial perspective
On This Day: St. Peter's Basilica

systems.name: Facade and vestibule
systems.description: Carlo Maderno's 51 m high, 114 m wide facade with its giant order of columns, five portals and thirteen attic statues, and the 71 m wide vestibule behind it.

systems.name: Nave and crossing
systems.description: The long nave in three bays with its barrel vault, the side aisles, and the four great piers carrying the dome.

systems.name: Transept and apse
systems.description: The 150 m wide transept arms and the semicircular apse with its semi-dome conch at the west end.

systems.name: Dome
systems.description: Michelangelo's dome: the 190 m circumference drum, the 42 m shell with sixteen ribs, and the lantern, ball and cross rising to 136.6 m.

systems.name: Baldachin
systems.description: Bernini's 28.5 m bronze canopy over the high altar, with four 11 m helical columns.

systems.name: Colonnade
systems.description: Bernini's elliptical colonnade: two 93 m arms of 284 columns, 88 pilasters and 140 statues embracing St Peter's Square.

systems.name: Square and obelisk
systems.description: St Peter's Square with the Vatican obelisk, 25.5 m of shaft rising to 40 m with base and cross, and the two fountains.

systems.name: Chapels and towers
systems.description: The chapels off the aisles, the two clock towers flanking the facade, and the sacristy block.
